description: Lists or extracts game packs and archives. Godot .pck (also embedded in an exported .exe/.x86_64; MD5-checked). Unity asset bundles (UnityFS, LZ4/LZMA) and serialized files (data.unity3d, level0, sharedassets0.assets, globalgamemanagers): every object by class and name, bundle container paths, the C# scripts MonoBehaviours use (with counts), the build's scene list; extract writes Texture2D as PNG (DXT1/5, BC4/5, ETC1/ETC2/ETC2+EAC, 8-bit raw formats; ASTC as .astc, BC6H/BC7 as .dds, others raw), Mesh as OBJ (with type trees), AudioClip as its FSB5 bank, TextAsset as text and other objects as JSON (bundles) or raw bytes (player builds strip type trees). ZIP family (apk, jar, ipa), tar/tar.gz (.unitypackage), Electron .asar, Ren'Py .rpa, GameMaker data.win (PNG/QOI, WAV/OGG), FMOD .bank and .fsb (PCM as WAV), Wwise .bnk, Unreal .pak v1–v11 (stored/Zlib extract), Quake .pak and Doom .wad (map lumps extract into their map folder), Flash .swf (CWS and ZWS inflate), Unity WebGL and Emscripten .data. An .apk also gets android: the binary AndroidManifest.xml decoded (package, versions, SDK levels, permissions, activities with the launcher, flags such as debuggable) with labels resolved through resources.arsc, and its native ABIs; an .ipa gets ios: Info.plist (bundle id, version, minimum OS, URL schemes, permission texts). Encrypted packs/entries are reported, never decrypted.

manifest.description: apk: add the decoded AndroidManifest.xml as text; ipa: add the whole Info.plist (default false: the summary only).

match.description: Only entries matching: substring, glob (*.gd, scenes/*.tscn) or /regex/.

resourceStrings.description: apk: list this many string resources from resources.arsc (default 0).

name: re_archive
title: List or extract a pack/archive
